notes: «كلاهما عن سفيان الثوري، عن طلحة بن يحيى، بإسناد وكيع» is read as the tail of all three branches, as the text writes it once after the last ح; the first branch's طلحة and the tail's طلحة are two written occurrences, both kept.
«بإسناد وكيع نحو حديثه» is a back_reference closing the route; the wording remark is left out.
